title: Traditional Dutch rice tart (rijstevlaai)
hookLine: Global-inspired traditional dutch rice tart (rijstevlaai) with 14 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the oven to 180°C. For the dough, mix flour and sugar in a bowl. Heat the 100 grams of milk to lukewarm and dissolve the yeast in it. Let stand for a while until it starts to bubble. Then add to the flour along with the coconut oil and mix into a smooth dough. Let rise for 30 minutes, covered, in a warm place. Incorporate {m53391_1}, {m53391_2}, {m53391_3}, and {m53391_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, make the rice pudding by putting the rice with sugar, milk and vanilla extract in a saucepan. Add the cardamom, star anise and cinnamon. Bring to a boil and cook, stirring constantly. Take out the spices. In a small bowl, mix baking soda with lemon juice/apple vinegar. Stir well until baking soda is dissolved, then mix into the rice pudding. Incorporate {m53391_5}, {m53391_6}, and {m53391_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53391_8}, {m53391_9}, {m53391_10}, {m53391_11}, {m53391_12}, {m53391_13}, and {m53391_14} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll out the dough on a floured work surface (it is very sticky, but don’t stress it will be fine) and line the bottom and edges of a greased mold with it. Spread the rice pudding over the bottom and bake for about 25 to 30 minutes.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
